notes: How to read audit_summary.json: it is built by summarize(net_records) restricted to AUDITED_FIELDS (fec/cleaning/audit.py:26-33). A step is absent when it made 0 changes, when every change was later reverted (net_records removes the whole chain), or when it wrote only unaudited columns (occupation_status, committee_type, donor_key, _reclass_reason). The summary order is the order of each step's first surviving record, and it matches code order for every step in this area.
